meta.title: Plan My Trip · Bespoke Sri Lanka Inquiry
meta.description: Tell me about your dream Sri Lanka journey — your party, dates, pace and passions — and I will personally send you a bespoke itinerary blueprint within 24 hours. No payment, no obligation.

hero.pill: 100% Bespoke Private Journeys · Zero Obligation Consultations
hero.title: Tell Me About Your Dream Ceylon Journey
hero.intro: Every expedition is crafted personally by me, {name}. Share your aspirations below, and I will assemble an exquisite, customized blueprint tailored to your exact pace within 24 hours.

wizard.draftRestored: I restored the answers you started earlier.

party.title: Who will be joining you on this journey?
party.intro: Select the arrangement that best matches your party to help me arrange optimal transport and room layouts.

family.title: Family with Kids
family.body: Spacious multi-room villas, gentle wildlife & safe coastal bays.

group.title: Friends & Small Group
group.body: Private estate buyouts, private van & convivial dining.

corporate.title: Corporate / Executive Delegation
corporate.body: High-level VIP privacy, luxury Mercedes-Benz coach, discreet executive hosts.

party.guestsBody: Used to secure luxury seating configurations and vehicle types.

dates.title: When are you hoping to visit Ceylon?
dates.intro: Sri Lanka enjoys dual monsoon microclimates; I align your destinations with optimal coastal sunshine and dry highland valleys.

flexible.title: Not Sure Yet
flexible.body: Recommend based on our dream highlights & pace

relaxed.title: Relaxed & Unhurried
relaxed.body: 2–3 night minimum stays per boutique villa, leisurely late brunches, quiet afternoon poolside rests.

balanced.title: Balanced & Curious
balanced.body: Morning temple or wildlife explorations, comfortable transfers, free twilight hours for personal discovery.

active.title: Active & Immersive
active.body: Dawn bird walks, mountain treks, multiple safari drives, and high-frequency cultural immersion.

passions.title: What stirs your imagination about Sri Lanka?
passions.intro: Select all experiences that spark your wanderlust. I curate private, crowd-free timings for each.

bungalows.title: Heritage Tea Bungalows
bungalows.body: Colonial planter mansions, manicured lawns, log fireplaces, personal butlers.

safari_pavilions.title: Eco-Luxury Forest Pavilions
safari_pavilions.body: Architectural open-air pavilions enveloped by jungle sounds and untouched flora.

ocean_resorts.title: 5-Star Oceanfront Boutique
ocean_resorts.body: Bawa-inspired cliffside suites, infinity pools over the Indian Ocean, private beach coves.

blend.title: Curated Blend of Unique Villas
blend.body: A handpicked progression transitioning smoothly from tea country to coastal sanctuaries.

details.title: Where should I send your blueprint?
details.intro: Your details remain strictly confidential and are used solely to draft your personalized expedition itinerary.
details.name: Full Name
details.whatsappOtherHint: Please include your country code, e.g. +353 85 123 4567.
details.messagePlaceholder: Mention any milestone anniversaries, special dietary preferences (gluten-free, vegan, halal), architectural passions (Geoffrey Bawa fans), or specific national parks you wish to prioritize...
details.guaranteeTitle: No Payment, No Obligation · 100% Bespoke Consultation
details.guaranteeBody: Nothing is paid or booked through this website. I design your itinerary blueprint personally and refine it with you, free of any commitment, until you are thrilled.

success.title: Ayubowan! Your Blueprint Request is Received.
success.body: I am reviewing your travel preferences now. Expect a customized blueprint in your inbox and a brief hello on WhatsApp within 24 hours.
success.referenceHint: Please mention it when we talk — it helps me find your notes instantly.
success.whatsappLead: Need immediate answers? Message me directly at
success.whatsappMessage: Hello {name}, I have just sent my trip inquiry (reference {reference}) and would love to chat.

concierge.label: Your personal guide
concierge.awayLabel: Outside my working hours — I will reply first thing in the morning
concierge.quote: “Welcome to Serendiva. As your personal expedition architect and host, I personally accompany and curate your time in Ceylon. No call centers, no canned itineraries.”

bullets.direct: Direct guide contact — no agencies, no middlemen

concierge.photoQuote: “Sri Lanka is not a trip; it is an enduring memory.”
concierge.unavailable: My contact details couldn't be loaded right now — WhatsApp and email still reach me.

process.title: How My Bespoke Planning Works
process.intro: From the moment you share your initial thoughts to your final farewell at Bandaranaike International, every detail is seamlessly orchestrated.

share.title: Share Intentions
share.body: Submit this inquiry or send me a quick WhatsApp note outlining your preferred season, party size, and travel pace.

curate.title: Collaborative Curation
curate.body: Receive a comprehensive initial draft blueprint within 24 hours featuring handpicked villas, routes, and scenic timing.

refine.title: Refine & Perfect
refine.body: Adjust hotel tiers, switch safari locations, or extend beach time with me over direct WhatsApp audio calls.

welcome.title: Effortless Welcome
welcome.body: Meet me in VIP arrivals at Colombo with fresh cold towels, chilled coconuts, and your executive private vehicle.

coverage.title: From the Northern Tip of Jaffna to the Colonial Ramparts of Galle
coverage.body: I maintain active concierge networks across all 9 provinces. Whether arranging private dawn seaplane connections to Castlereagh Reservoir, priority safari permits into Yala Block 1, or secluded coastal villas in Tangalle, my on-ground coordination is absolute.
